closure_definition: a request can be submitted, reviewed, and observed through a clear final status

acceptance_criteria.description: authorized reviewer can approve a complete request
acceptance_criteria.example_input: request includes required business details and reviewer has permission to decide
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: request status changes to approved and requester sees the next action
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: request missing required details stays pending with a clear correction prompt
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: unauthorized reviewer cannot change status and requester sees no false approval

priority_basis: the first closed-loop path must be clear before adding variants

protected_behaviors: Director-confirmed scope and business outcomes remain unchanged during PM refinement
business_constraints: Product Manager artifacts describe WHAT-layer behavior and leave technical implementation to design

verification_plan.business_operation: submit a complete request, record an approval decision, and inspect requester-visible status
verification_plan.expected_observation: approved status and next action are visible without changing excluded behavior
